rationale: DRAFT_UNSIGNED: proposes adoption of requirements revision 63 and architecture revision 9 for the Phase 3 Operations-wallet money path. It freezes persisted Relay settlement, first-use standing-authority reservations, typed minima and mandatory gas caps, split provider-graph and owner-seed launch atomicity, and durable payout recovery. This draft grants no deployment, credential use, signing, broadcast, asset movement, spending, or publication authority.
